changelog: Receipt: Print/Close buttons stay fixed at bottom; receipt content scrolls up/down
Sticker print: Print button stays fixed; stickers scroll when there are many
Products page: Low Stock filter button now works (shows items where stock <= min stock)
Products page: Expiry filter button now works (shows items expiring within 30 days)
Add Product: Box-to-piece stock auto-calc now works even without box barcode (just fill pieces per box + number of boxes)
Filter buttons toggle on/off when clicked again
